sampling.bin_candidate_order: SHA256(seed|segment|bin_y|bin_x): first uint64 big-endian gives start mod N; second gives a positive stride advanced cyclically until coprime with N; traverse the resulting row-major permutation
sampling.bin_edges: integer floor(k*n/bins), clipped to the one-pixel interior
sampling.coordinate_convention: target base-voxel centers; no half-voxel translation
sampling.interpolation: trilinear floor-plus-eight-neighbors; reject if the complete cube is out of bounds
sampling.median_convention: arithmetic midpoint of the two central values for even counts

selection_algorithm: per bin SHA256(seed|segment|bin_y|bin_x): first 8 digest bytes select start; next 8 select stride, advanced with wrap to the first coprime value; choose the first eligible row-major bin position on the full cycle
